measurement_caveats: Candidates are measured under temporary patch/MethodType/finally-restoration adapters; baseline has no equivalent adapter.
Min candidate additionally uses uncached signature dispatch in ComposedFunction. This affects timings and tracked allocations at every size; intrinsic kernel differences are not isolated.
Gallagher candidate equals baseline; its timing difference is repeat noise, not an optimization.
RSS is combined-worker lifetime maximum, not separate per-variant/native-allocation evidence.
No production numerical adoption justified by these probe results.
